nodes.dialogue_text: Brihannala! Turn the chariot back! That is Bhishma, that is Drona, and that is Karna! I am but a boy, I cannot fight them!
Hold the reins, Prince Uttara. You are the charioteer today, and I am the warrior. Dig into the Shami tree and retrieve my weapons.

choices.choice_text: [Unwrap the Gandiva bow. Blow the Devadatta conch.]

nodes.dialogue_text: That sound... The twang of that bowstring and the roar of that conch. The 13 years have ended, Duryodhana. Arjuna is here.
I will not kill them today; they are my elders and kin. But they must learn who stands against them. I invoke the Sammohana Astra!
